title: Prism Mite Cluster
text: Prism Mite Cluster covers lenses and antennae with tiny bodies that split one signal into a hundred. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Each wing reflects a different warning.

defeatReward.text: Prism Mite Cluster is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
